title: Ankara Prosecutors Open Unprecedented 'Insulting the President' Probe Into Ex-PM Davutoğlu
detail: The Ankara Chief Public Prosecutor's Office opened an investigation into former Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ahmet Davutoğlu under Article 299 of the Turkish Penal Code ('insulting the president'), after a resurfaced video showed him telling villagers, while leading the now-dissolved opposition Future Party, that ministers who followed him had 'added billions to their billions, amassed ill-gotten gains and enriched their entourage,' and that the president had made his son-in-law a minister. The offense carries up to four years in prison. Davutoğlu — an AKP co-founder and Erdoğan's former chief strategist turned critic, whose Future Party announced its dissolution on July 30, 2026 — was later summoned for questioning, a step commentators called unprecedented for a former prime minister.

media.caption: Ahmet Davutoğlu faces a criminal probe over remarks deemed insulting to President Erdoğan
